body.sql: SELECT id FROM workspaces WHERE id = ?

SELECT
            id,
            content,
            facets_json,
            created_by,
            valid_from_unix,
            valid_until_unix,
            source_ref,
            supersedes,
            created_at_unix,
            version
          FROM agent_facts
          WHERE schema_id = ?
            AND workspace_id = ?
            AND (valid_until_unix IS NULL OR valid_until_unix > strftime('%s','now'))
            
            AND json_extract(facets_json, '$.record_id') = ?
          ORDER BY updated_at_unix DESC, created_at_unix DESC
          LIMIT 1

INSERT INTO agent_facts (
            id,
            schema_id,
            source_ref,
            content,
            facets,
            facets_json,
            embedding_blob,
            created_by,
            created_at_unix,
            updated_at_unix,
            valid_from_unix,
            valid_until_unix,
            version,
            doc_id,
            workspace_id
          )
          VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 1, (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(doc_id), 0) + 1 FROM agent_facts), ?)
          ON CONFLICT(source_ref, workspace_id) WHERE source_ref IS NOT NULL
          DO UPDATE SET
            schema_id = excluded.schema_id,
            content = excluded.content,
            facets = excluded.facets,
            facets_json = excluded.facets_json,
            embedding_blob = COALESCE(
              excluded.embedding_blob,
              agent_facts.embedding_blob
            ),
            created_by = COALESCE(
              excluded.created_by,
              agent_facts.created_by
            ),
            updated_at_unix = excluded.updated_at_unix,
            valid_until_unix = excluded.valid_until_unix,
            version = agent_facts.version + 1

SELECT id, doc_id, created_at_unix, version
          FROM agent_facts
          WHERE id = ?

SELECT
            id,
            content,
            facets_json,
            created_by,
            valid_from_unix,
            valid_until_unix,
            source_ref,
            supersedes,
            created_at_unix,
            version
          FROM agent_facts
          WHERE schema_id = ?
            AND workspace_id = ?
            AND (valid_until_unix IS NULL OR valid_until_unix > strftime('%s','now'))
            
            AND json_extract(facets_json, '$.record_id') = ?
          ORDER BY updated_at_unix DESC, created_at_unix DESC
          LIMIT 1

INSERT INTO agent_facts (
                id, workspace_id, schema_id, source_ref, content,
                facets, facets_json, created_by, created_at_unix,
                updated_at_unix, valid_from_unix, valid_until_unix,
                version, supersedes, doc_id
              )
              SELECT
                ?,
                workspace_id,
                schema_id,
                CASE
                  WHEN source_ref IS NULL THEN NULL
                  ELSE source_ref || '#v' || version
                END,
                content,
                facets_json,
                facets_json,
                created_by,
                created_at_unix,
                ?,
                valid_from_unix,
                MAX(COALESCE(valid_from_unix, CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)), CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)),
                version,
                supersedes,
                NULL
              FROM agent_facts
              WHERE id = ?
SELECT id FROM agent_facts WHERE id = ?

UPDATE agent_facts
            SET content = ?,
                facets = ?,
                facets_json = ?,
                -- Only a content change may touch the vector. A facets-only
                -- update leaves the text alone, so blanking the embedding here
                -- would drop the row out of the semantic pool
                -- (embedding_blob IS NOT NULL) for content that never changed,
                -- while search_embeddings still holds the old vector.
                embedding_blob = CASE WHEN ? = 1 THEN ? ELSE embedding_blob END,
                created_by = ?,
                valid_until_unix = ?,
                updated_at_unix = ?,
                supersedes = COALESCE(?, supersedes),
                version = version + 1
            WHERE id = ?

SELECT id, doc_id, updated_at_unix, version
            FROM agent_facts
            WHERE id = ?
